special_traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
special_traits.description:
If the pit fiend dies outside the
Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

special_traits.name: Fear Aura
special_traits.description: The pit fiend emanates an aura in a 20-

special_traits.name: foot Emanation while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition
special_traits.description:
Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 21, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this pit fiend's aura
for 24 hours.

special_traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
special_traits.description:
If the pit fiend fails a
saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

special_traits.name: Magic Resistance
special_traits.description:
The pit fiend has Advantage on sav-
ing throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The pit fiend makes one Bite attack, two
Devilish Claw attacks, and one Fiery Mace attack.

actions.description:

+ 8) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make the following saving throw. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The target has the Poisoned
